show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/5ZKPhe
show.description: Ishan, a tech prodigy saves Vaayu Tech from cyberattacks but is wrongly humiliated and fired by the arrogant new COO, Arjun Malhotra. Stripped of respect, Ishan is rescued by his old friend Vanya, CEO of a rival startup, India Pay. With her support and a loyal team, he rebuilds his career and wages a corporate war of brains and revenge against Vaayu Tech. Watch now.
